name: End level
description: Ends the level the way the goal sphere does: the end level timer ($1493) is set to $FF, and the goal type ($141C) to 0 for the normal exit or 1 for secret exit 1. The level clear music is not played. 'Event + n' adds n to the overworld event to run at the end of the level ($1DEA) first, to reach the event of a further secret exit, as the Exit Adder block (SMWC 4073) does; an event of $FF (none) is left alone.
author: BlockCreator
